column3: With respect to the Ellenton Premium Outlets Mortgage Loan (3.1%), at origination, in lieu of making the upfront TI/LC deposit, the guarantor delivered a limited payment guaranty in an amount equal to $1,472,100. Additionally, the borrower has the right, in lieu of making cash deposits into the reserve accounts, to provide a letter of credit from Simon Property Group, Inc., an affiliate of the borrower sponsor.
